messages:
Mira (Product): Follow-up from today's AH Q&A: please dump quick notes about customer wins/losses and what actually moved the needle. I'll synthesize.
Jon (Sales): Win: medtech chose us — biggest reason was our audit logs + predictable Dedicated throughput.
Jon (Sales): Loss: adtech went with competitor because they needed customer-managed HSM + 5yr retention.
Pri (CS): Repeated asks across accounts: KMS/HSM, longer trace retention, clearer deployment docs, and a rollback SLA for model regressions.
Arjun (SE): Technical nuance on wins: per-route pinning + fallback policy saved one deal during a simulated outage. On losses: cold-start tail often cited, sample: `burst p99=230ms`, req <140ms.
Casey (Security): For KMS we need a spec: supported key flows, rotation, and an attestation template. We can produce a scoped attestation short-term.
Ellen (CEO): Priorities: 1) 60-day tactical: attestation template, audit checklist, Dedicated vs Private one-pager. 2) Quarter: customer-managed keys + retention controls.
Mira (Product): Action owners: Jon -> list top 12 lost deals with blockers (48h). Arjun -> draft p99 mitigation + warm-pool runbook (72h). Pri -> audit checklist draft (72h). Casey -> attestation template (48h).
OpsBot: CI job queued: perf/repro-tail-latency#88 (will post results in ops channel).
Jon (Sales): Can Legal sign a short-term addendum for a few prioritized deals? That would shorten the pipeline.
Casey (Security): Yes, but need Product scope + expiration. Mira, please include criteria in the GH issue.
Mira (Product): Will post GH project and link here: https://go.redwood/ah-wins-losses-2026 and schedule 30-min triage Friday 10am PT. Keep replies concise so we can move fast. :rocket:
